slice.title: Confirm before deleting a note
slice.goal: Before deleting a note, ask the user to confirm the destructive action.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking Delete does not immediately delete the note; it shows a confirmation state.
Clicking Cancel hides the confirmation state and keeps the note unchanged.
Clicking Confirm deletes the note and refreshes the list.
Delete, Confirm, and Cancel controls have stable data-prototype-id anchors linked to scheme actions.
Existing backend DELETE behavior remains valid.

notes: This is the canonical scenario input expected from a future requirements stage.
implementation_slice.json is a generated compatibility view for the current planning prompts.
